description: This file defines the ResourceLimitChecks interface that specifies methods to check resource limits (connections and messages) for tenants in a service. It includes method signatures for checking whether connection or message limits have been reached, with results delivered asynchronously via futures.

classes.name: ResourceLimitChecks
classes.description: Interface to check if further connections or messages are allowed based on configured limits.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if the maximum number of connections configured for a tenant have been reached, returning a Future<Boolean> indicating the result.

methods.name: isMessageLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if the maximum message limit has been reached for a tenant given the payload size, returning a Future<Boolean> indicating the result.
